newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - ITT Hartford rated buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - ITT Hartford rated buy.

text.p: -- Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette analyst David Seifer said he started coverage of ITT Hartford Group Inc with a buy rating.
-- Said he estimates 1996 earnings at $4.20 a share and 1997 earnings at $6.30 a share.
-- Said he set a 12-month price target of $79 a share.

-- Said he rates ITT Hartford a buy based on its positive position in variable annuities and strong relationship in the market for retired persons. Also expects improvement in insurer's more traditional commercial line business.
